query: What praise and complaints appear in IMDb reviews?

per_column.name: overall_stance
per_column.rationale: Adds a mixed category beyond the existing label_pos binary, giving finer stance grouping. Partly redundant with label_pos but the 'mixed' tier adds leverage. Values align with source samples.

per_column.name: acting_assessment
per_column.rationale: Aspect-level valence directly serves the praise/complaint query. Grounded: IMDB-0004 acting 'pretty good'=praised, IMDB-0003 'wooden'=criticised. IMDB-0001 lacks acting mention yet marked criticised, a minor over-assertion.

per_column.name: writing_script_assessment
per_column.rationale: Genuine aspect axis. IMDB-0001 'writing beyond insipid'=criticised is well grounded; silent rows marked not_present correctly.

per_column.name: directing_assessment
per_column.rationale: Useful aspect. Some samples (IMDB-0001, 0002) marked criticised where directing isn't explicitly discussed, suggesting over-attribution from overall negativity.

per_column.name: technical_production_assessment
per_column.rationale: Valid production axis. IMDB-0004 'well-made'=praised is grounded; but IMDB-0001/0002 criticised without clear technical comment indicates halo-effect labeling.

per_column.name: story_plot_assessment
per_column.rationale: Strong aspect for the query. IMDB-0005 'mixed' fits the frustrating-yet-engaging text; some negative rows may inherit stance rather than explicit plot judgment.

per_column.name: pacing_engagement_assessment
per_column.rationale: Useful engagement axis. However IMDB-0001/0002 'boring_or_slow' and IMDB-0004/0005 'engaging' are inferred; pacing is rarely explicitly stated, so several values are weakly warranted.

per_column.name: specific_praised_element
per_column.rationale: Directly captures praise for the query with concrete categories. IMDB-0004 performance_standout grounded; silent rows correctly not_present.

per_column.name: specific_complained_element
per_column.rationale: Directly captures complaints, the core of the query. IMDB-0001 script_or_dialogue, IMDB-0003 acting_performance well grounded.

per_column.name: audience_recommendation
per_column.rationale: Adds a recommend/discourage axis with a caveats tier, useful for actionable grouping. IMDB-0004 'must see'=recommends grounded; some values inferred from stance but reasonable.

judge.rationale: The added columns form a coherent aspect-based sentiment decomposition (acting, writing, directing, technical, plot, pacing) plus explicit praised/complained-element extractions and a recommendation flag, all of which give genuine analytical leverage for a praise/complaints query well beyond the original binary label. Groundedness is generally sound where the source explicitly discusses an aspect, and silent rows are appropriately marked not_present. The main weakness is a halo effect: for strongly negative reviews, several aspect columns (directing, technical, pacing) are labeled criticised/boring even when the text does not explicitly evaluate that aspect, constituting mild over-attribution. This lowers but does not undermine overall quality.
